ModMetaData.name: Vacuum Chamber
ModMetaData.description:
Adds a Spacer-tier, rotatable Vacuum Chamber building capable of depressurizing and pressurizing enclosed indoor rooms to maintain partial or full vacuum using ISO 3529 vacuum technology physics.
Features: - Adjust target vacuum (0% to 100%) and pumping/pressurization speed level (1 to 50, at 100 m³/h and 250 W per level). - Depressurizes when current vacuum is below target, and pressurizes when current vacuum exceeds target. - Operates on both orbital/space maps and sealed planetary rooms. - Automatic state transitions between Unpowered, Operational, and Inoperable (outdoors/unsealed) with automatic recovery once repaired.
